requirement_owned_vector_families.generation_gate: production writer, independent verifier codec, and test oracle independently generate byte-identical valid bytes and identical mutation classifications using only the frozen batch-027 requirements plus this plan; no implementation source is shared

deterministic_generator.inputs: only constants and algorithms frozen in the generator and fixture manifest; no random source, wall clock, environment value, filesystem enumeration, user input, or implementation-selected seed
deterministic_generator.scope: plan-authoring provenance only; forbidden as production writer, verifier, parser, oracle, fixture builder, or imported implementation dependency

independent_semantic_verifier.required_engine: PowerShell 7.x (Core); other PowerShell editions and major versions are outside the supported and acceptance scope
independent_semantic_verifier.independence: PowerShell implementation; does not invoke, import, translate, or share codec functions with the Python generator

validation_rule: The seven inline legacy vectors and the bound U-001 binary corpus are both normative. A conforming writer, verifier codec, and independent test oracle must each reproduce every indexed byte/hash, return every frozen classification, and cover every manifest-required family without importing the plan generator or code from either other implementation. Token presence is not coverage evidence. Generated batch-027 vectors must match the exact requirement-owned framing, bootstrap, mapping-header, presence, witness, state, deadline, and semantic rules.
version_evolution: Any changed vector byte or hash is a normative plan change requiring a new reviewed snapshot.
